source_text: Festa legis in Christo implentur — pascha, pentecoste, scenopegia. Gloria ei in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Feasts of-law in Christ are-fulfilled — passover, pentecost, tabernacles. Glory to-him into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: The law’s feasts are fulfilled in Christ — Passover, Pentecost, Tabernacles. Glory to him forever. Amen.
